proof_body:
by
  intro α _ S hS
  have h0 : ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, ((-1 : ℤ)) ^ U.card = 0 := Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card_of_nonempty hS
  have h1 : ∑ U ∈ S.powerset, ((-1 : ℤ)) ^ U.card = ((S.powerset.filter (fun U => Even U.card)).card : ℤ) - (S.powerset.filter (fun U => ¬ Even U.card)).card := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not S.powerset (fun U => Even U.card)]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun U hU => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hU).2.neg_one_pow), Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := S.powerset.filter (fun U => ¬ Even U.card)) rfl (fun U hU => (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hU).2).neg_one_pow)]
    simp
    ring
  have h2 := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S.powerset) (fun U => Even U.card)
  rw [Finset.card_powerset] at h2
  have hE : (S.powerset.filter (fun U => Even U.card)).card = (S.powerset.filter (fun U => ¬ Even U.card)).card := by
    have : ((S.powerset.filter (fun U => Even U.card)).card : ℤ) = (S.powerset.filter (fun U => ¬ Even U.card)).card := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hpos : 0 < S.card := hS.card_pos
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, S.card = m + 1 := ⟨S.card - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [hm, pow_succ] at h2
  rw [hm, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  omega
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α), S.Nonempty → (S.powerset.filter (fun U => Even U.card)).card = 2 ^ (S.card - 1)
